title: Interpreting the Morbidity Gap
abstract: arXiv:2611.26365v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Global Burden of Disease (GBD) study now reports the morbidity gap (MG), life expectancy minus healthy life expectancy, as an indicator in its own right. Writing MG as the expected cumulative rate of years lived with disability (YLDs) at the life-table age at death, we use stochastic dominance results to show what MG measures, how it responds to mortality and how it relates to the YLDs of the current population. We show the following. (a) A YLD profile gives an MG no larger than another's under every life table if and only if its cumulative YLD rate is nowhere higher. (b) With YLD rates fixed, lower mortality at every age widens MG, so that removing a risk factor that raises mortality reduces MG by less than its contribution to MG in GBD's risk factor attribution. (c) A family of results gives easily interpretable conditions on the age structure of the population for the crude YLD rate to be above or below the life-table YLD rate,

translated_abstract: 全球疾病负担研究现在将患病差距（MG）——即预期寿命减去健康预期寿命——作为一个独立指标进行报告。我们将MG表示为在寿命表死亡年龄处带残障生活年数的期望累积率，并利用随机占优理论的结果来阐明MG衡量的是什么、它如何随死亡率变化，以及它与当前人群带残障生活年数之间的关系。我们证明了以下结果： 其一，一个YLD（带残障生活年数）分布在任意寿命表下所产生的MG不大于另一个，当且仅当其累积YLD率在任何年龄处都不更高； 其二，在YLD率固定的情况下，每个年龄死亡率的降低都会扩大MG，因此消除一个提高死亡率的风险因素对MG的削减量，会小于其在GBD风险因素归因框架下对MG的贡献； 其三，一系列结果给出了易于解释的人群年龄结构条件，用以判定粗YLD率高于或低于寿命表YLD率的情形。
tldr: 本文利用随机占优理论首次对全球疾病负担研究中的患病差距（MG）给出严格的理论解读，证明累积YLD率决定MG的大小排序、降低死亡率反而会扩大MG，并给出了判定粗YLD率与寿命表YLD率相对大小的人群年龄结构条件。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first rigorous theoretical interpretation of the morbidity gap (MG) using stochastic dominance, showing that cumulative YLD rates determine the ordering of MG, that lower mortality widens MG, and deriving easily interpretable age-structure conditions for when crude YLD rates exceed life-table YLD rates.
